except.note: Without the keyring extra or a usable OS keyring the token is in a 0600 file; store_status() reports keyring-unavailable and supports() reports dependency (P1b-10).

core.store.note: keyring is an optional extra; without it the token is in a 0600 file and store_status() reports keyring-unavailable.

core.copy.note: polaris_key.copy serves copy_generated.py (from copy.en.json): message()/title() read the error-code, then gate, then activation table; activation_message()/activation_title() and describe_error() read typed activation results from the activation table only; unknown codes read COPY_FALLBACK naming the code; {name} placeholders fill or drop; register_locale('en', ...) is the host override layer. The hand-kept EN table is gone. tests/test_copy.py checks every table against copy.en.json.

license.manage.note: PX-W8: the device-limit result exposes manageUrl (validated), plus the return and key helpers.

config.mirror.note: The Python mirror is rendered by tools/gen-mirrors.ts.

telemetry.updates.note: core/update_journal.py UpdateJournal: at most 16 queued events ride each devices/report in updates, oldest first, dropped once a 200 delivers them.

devices.attest.note: P6-02: a CPython process has no platform attestation service; its devices stay at the basic trust level.

identity.oidc.note: Browser redirect sign-in waits on the native redirect-token route (I-15, SDK parity pass wire item W4). Until then identity.sign_in_with_browser() opens the device-code verificationUriComplete in the system browser and polls /identity/auth/device/poll (identity.devicecode); the old /identity/auth/poll is retired and the Worker no longer serves it.

identity.devicelabel.note: PX-W13: normalize_device_label (polaris_key.core.device_label), the device_name option and platform.node() without .local/.lan/.home by default, on begin_sign_in, activate_with_key and register; SignInPrompt.deviceName is the Worker's echo.

release.record.note: core/release_record.py verify_release_record (hash before signature, pinned release keys only, never a product key); client.update.release_record() and decide() fetch by hash and keep the releaseRecords slice while a committed feed pins it.

release.fetch.note: client.release.fetch(target, to=…): discovery's build template, device bearer and metadata headers, Range/If-Range resume, size and SHA-256 checked before the file appears.

update.feed.note: core/feed.py verify_feed with floors keyed by the canonical channel; client.update.feed() and decide() fetch, verify and commit the feeds cache slice, re-verified on load.

update.feeds.note: client.update.feed_url(kind) over discovery's update.endpoints (aliases canonicalised, values percent-encoded, velopack without a channel is the UpdateManager directory); tests/test_feed_url_matrix.py drives every feed-url-matrix.json row.

update.decide.note: core/decide.py decide_update over core/check.py run_update_check; client.update.decide() returns the UpdateCheck at the effective clock. The outlet is the host's UpdateClientOptions.outlet, else the in-process detection result (P3-11) over the stamp.

update.content.note: core/decide.py decide_update with content (feed_content, select_pack_rows, prestage, the content blocks and boot required for revoked required content); client.update.decide() builds content from the content stamp, the pack state, the variant preferences and the stored revocations (run_update_check steps 10-14).

update.driver.note: update/drivers.py: client.update.install(decision) over VelopackDriver (the velopack package's UpdateManager on discovery's Velopack feed; unsupported dependency without it), SelfReplaceDriver (a frozen single-file executable replaced with the release.fetch-verified build, the old one kept for the boot guard's rollback) and StoreLinkDriver (a store decision's listing); each records update_downloaded and update_applied. tests/test_drivers.py.

update.bootguard.note: update/bootguard.py BootGuard: update.mark_boot_attempt() at launch (client.boot() calls it) and update.confirm_boot() once healthy (boot() confirms per stage-matrix.json's bootConfirmation), slots in the state directory; after maxFailedBoots unconfirmed launches it rolls back through the install driver when one can (update_reverted, boot_rolled_back), otherwise reports boot_rolled_back with code no-previous once. tests/test_boot.py drives the guardCases.

outlet.detect.note: core/detection.py detect_outlet over update/outlet.py read_outlet_signals (environment, sys.executable and script path conventions, product-named markers, GetCurrentPackageFamilyName through ctypes); the update client detects when the host names no outlet. PEP 376 INSTALLER names no v4 signal and is not read.

packs.record.note: core.release_record verify_release_record with pin.kind (pack records fetched by the content stamp's pin, app content and builds[].embeds claims) and update.packs.verify_marker for embedded baselines; test_conformance drives every packRecordCases and markerCases vector, test_content_conformance the stampCases.

packs.revoke.note: core/release_record.py verify_revocation and newer_revocation; the PackEngine keeps verified revocations in the sibling revocations.json (revocationsStored, relearn, 256 targets) and refuses revoked mounts with pack-revoked.

packs.delegation.note: core/release_record.py verify_release_record (the delegated path, steps 13 and 16), verify_delegation, record_revoked and update/packs/dataonly.py data_only_refusal; the PackEngine fetches and caches delegations, refuses non-data-only delegated installs with pack-not-data-only, stores the install's delegation and refuses releases under a revoked delegation (pack-revoked, detail delegation); test_delegation_conformance drives every delegationCases and dataOnlyCases vector.

packs.plan.note: update.packs plan, select_variant and plan_target; every plan-matrix.json row, variant case and target case in test_plan_matrix.

packs.index.files.note: update.packs parse_files_index, check_paths and tree_digest; filesIndexCases under compression.zstd (3.14+) and zstandard.

packs.index.chunks.note: update.packs parse_chunk_index and parse_chunk_index_bytes (u64 from two u32 reads, saturated at 2^53); chunkIndexCases under compression.zstd (3.14+) and zstandard. Seed indexes are kept under <packs root>/index/<sha256> and re-verified on every use.

packs.apply.full.note: update.packs apply_full (streamed through decode_stream); applyCases under every backend the interpreter has.

packs.apply.file.note: update.packs apply_file with the type-neutral container rebuild; applyCases under every backend.

packs.apply.chunk.note: update.packs apply_chunk over seeds from every installed and embedded container (across packs), one bounded Range request per run with If-Range and Accept-Encoding: identity through chunk_range_fetch (exact Content-Range and ETag, never multi-range); a run journal resumes an interrupted install and a refused range falls back to the next strategy. applyCases under every backend the interpreter has.

packs.apply.delta.note: compression.zstd's ZstdDict(base, is_raw=True).as_prefix on 3.14+, zstandard's DICT_TYPE_RAWCONTENT below (a hard dependency there), window_log_max always set; the window check runs in the applier whatever the decoder, and a start-up probe gates zstd-patch-from.

packs.delta.feed.note: feed_content reads the feed's deltas menu (both caps, both uniqueness rules, a non-payload entry dropped alone), with_feed_deltas merges it into the selected container variant before plan_target, and PackEngine tries at most one feed-offered delta per install (fallback on a failed fetch or any delta verdict), journalling it as feedDelta for resume; UpdateClient wires feed_deltas to the committed feed (fresh or stale).

packs.state.note: update.packs PackEngine and the install-state machine over DirPackStorage in the platform data directory: journal, resume with Range/If-Range, atomic pointer swap with fsync, confirm, rollback, GC roots, a torn state.json held aside, an unreadable one refused, embedded baselines; packSetId on devices/report.

packs.handlers.note: client.update.packs.register_handler; files.tree (hot: versioned directory plus pointer swap), data.json and l10n.table built in; a handler's optional check(staged) runs over every newly staged payload before the state commit (pack-type-check-failed with detail and path), and a reads_payload handler's activate gets the installed payload (P4-16).

packs.provides.note: update.packs.provides reads the record-level provides (CONTENT_ID_PATTERN, MAX_PROVIDES; an unusable list provides nothing); client.update.packs.is_available over the running set and pack_for over a packs decision's targets or the stamp's pins, unentitled and revoked releases never answering.

packs.type.godot.zip.note: P4-16: a godot.zip is mounted only by Godot's load_resource_pack.

packs.type.l10n.table.note: P4-16: L10nTableHandler (built in): PO, CSV or JSON tables by content, plain parsers (never evaluated), each locale a well-formed BCP-47 tag matching the variant's locale axis; tables(pack_id), on_activate/on_deactivate.

packs.type.data.json.note: P4-16: DataJsonHandler (built in): every file one strict-JSON object (V4 §1.2), the format_versions the host lists; documents(pack_id), on_activate/on_deactivate.

packs.type.audio.bank.note: P4-16: audio banks load through a game engine's middleware.

packs.type.ml.model.note: P4-16: MlModelHandler (host-registered with runtimes, ram_bytes, vram_bytes, quantizations, load_test): model.json's runtime, quantisation and RAM/VRAM needs against the budget, then the load test, before model(pack_id) swaps.

packs.transport.steam.note: P5-08 covers Godot only; Python desktop hosts have no Steam-depot transport owner.

packs.transport.msix.note: No work package owns the MSIX optional-package transport (P5-08 Out).

packs.transport.flatpak.note: No work package owns the Flatpak extension transport (P5-08 Out).

ui.cli.note: The terminal kit (polaris_key.ui.terminal, UK-13): every verb of the argparse, click and typer front ends drawn to UI-KITS §1.4 Terminal, with --json on every verb, over polaris_key.ui.core's headless models. Proofs: tests/cli/test_golden.py (golden ANSI in every variant and SVG for 70 component states in both themes), tests/cli/test_lint.py (catalog strings, 80/60 columns, piped output, RTL-safe source), tests/cli/test_flows.py (interactive flows with scripted keys, and rich's bytes against the kit's), tests/cli/test_responsive.py (the resolution matrix in pyte with soft-wrap marks and reflow: 40/60/80/120 columns at 12 and 24 rows with long values, de and ja at 40 and 60, and an 80 to 50 resize mid-flow by SIGWINCH; no line wider than the terminal, no URL or code cut, the code, URL and keys in view) and tests/cli/test_textual.py. The ui.gate … ui.i18n rows are UK-02b's and do not exist yet.

commerce.receipt.note: polaris_key.commerce: binding() and claim(store, payload) over the P6-01 bridge, plus claim_steam(ticket_hex, dlc_app_id), claim_play() and claim_app_store(), which sync on success; the host's Steamworks binding supplies the ticket, so there is no store dependency. Refusals keep the server's code and reason (ClaimNotOwned, ClaimAttestationRequired, ClaimRefused). tests/test_commerce.py and the commerce-claim transcript.
